tool.name: lookup_caller_work_en
tool.description: Record lookup: finds the existing work of the customer registered to this phone number. Use it when the caller asks how existing work, a quote or a visit is going. In the result, known says whether a customer record was found, name is the name on the record, open_work is open work with its due date, upcoming_visits are visits from today on, and estimates are estimates with their status. It holds only facts from the record.
